name: services/adm_documents/get_upd
description: Get selected administration document UPD of a given user.
brief_description: Get selected administration document UPD of a given user.
returns:
HTTP 200 response with raw contents of UPD as XML file.

If no such document exists, does not have UPD or you don't have access to it, this method will respond with HTTP 400 error.
errors: • object_not_found - some of the referenced objects do not exist.
